review:
Rise of Fortuna is built around wheels. When a Fortuna symbol lands it triggers a Regular, Super or Epic Fortuna Wheel, whose arrow stops on one of 12 slices containing additive multipliers, multiplicative multipliers or jackpot prizes. Every wheel value is collected by the Cash Prize Bar and paid as a multiple of your bet.

Three FS symbols give 10 free spins with more wheels, four give 10 spins where every wheel is Super or Epic, and five unlock the strongest bonus. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP, volatility or max win outside the game. It suits players who like wheel features.
